verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs list tensor, pipeline, and data parallelism (plus expert and context parallelism) as built-in distributed-inference features, which covers all three modes the story names. The support rests on a single feature-list line. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on configuring multi-GPU and multi-node parallelism, independent or hands-on corroboration of distributed inference working in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can distribute inference across multiple GPUs using tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism

citations.quote: Tensor, pipeline, data, expert, and context parallelism for distributed inference
